name: Excluding Ties in Percentile Ranks via EXCLUDE TIES
description: When evaluating employee sales performance, ties should not inflate the percentile score against colleagues who achieved the exact same result.
prompt:
When evaluating employee sales performance, ties should not inflate the percentile score against colleagues who achieved the exact same result.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: rep_id, sales_quota_achieved, cumulative_sales_exclusive_of_ties.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Compute cumulative sales sum excluding tied peers in current row calculation
            SELECT 
                rep_id,
                sales_quota_achieved,
                SUM(sales_quota_achieved) OVER (
                    ORDER BY sales_quota_achieved DESC
                    RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    EXCLUDE TIES
                ) AS cumulative_sales_exclusive_of_ties
            FROM rep_sales
            ORDER BY sales_quota_achieved DESC, rep_id;
why_it_fails: Using standard RANK() causes tied individuals to push each other's percentiles higher or lower inconsistently.
